items.text: Minnesota (Wednesday): RB Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) and G Joe Huber (knee) did not practice; RT Brian O'Neill (knee) was limited. Jordan Mason would lead the backfield if Jones sits.

Detroit: RB Jahmyr Gibbs (shoulder) and WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ankle) returned to full practice Thursday after sitting Wednesday, as did all rest-day starters. S Kerby Joseph (knee, 21-day window) and CB Ennis Rakestraw Jr. (ankle) were limited again.
